notes.title: ✨New Patch Available Now✨
notes.notes:
Dear travelers, 

We're happy to let you know that the new patch is now available! We hope that with these fixes you will continue your wholesome journey through Moominvalley without those mischievous bugs. We'd like to thank you once again for your continuous support and your dedication to restoring the valley to its natural beauty💚


 Fixed the issue with the audio not playing properly.
 Fixed the critical issue with the Barometer scene freezing and preventing progress.
 Reworked the save system to prevent various fail states throughout the game.
 Implemented improvements for cutscene transitions.

If you encounter other technical issues, please report them here - this is the quickest way for the dev team to have a look.

/ Snufkin Team

notes.title: 🌿Patch Notes🌿
notes.notes:
Dear travelers,

We're happy to let you know that we've released a patch to make your journeys even smoother and more enjoyable✨ See the notes below!


Minor spoiler: [spoiler]Players will now be able to continue from right before the point-of-no-return when you have completed the game. This means you can now choose to explore Moominvalley as if before the end of the game[/spoiler]
Fixed the issue where players were unable to change their game resolution.
Fixed the issue where Little My would get stuck at the entrance of a cave.
Fixed the issue with the save files, where the performance of the game would significantly drop and sometimes result in a crash.
Fixed the issue with dancing police officers (while we love dancing, it was not adhering to the rules the police officers are overseeing)

notes.notes:

notes.title: 📢Release Date Announcement!📢
notes.notes:
Dear wanderers,

When spring arrives and snow starts melting, Snufkin’s journey back to Moominvalley begins. We are thrilled to announce that Snufkin: Melody of Moominvalley will release on March 7, 2024 for PC Steam and Nintendo Switch! 

Inspired by the beloved Moomin stories from Tove Jansson, our musical adventure game is a heartwarming journey to restore harmony in nature. As Snufkin, players will sneak into parks and dismantle the horrid manicured and gated lawns. You will also meet over 50 various creatures and characters, forming wonderful friendships and cherished connections.

Please view our release date announcement trailer below 👇

[previewyoutube=2QF4lL10yCc;full][/previewyoutube]

Explore our open-world storybook by trekking through forests or leaving fast-fading footprints on the beaches. Set sail for Hattifatteners’ island and step into a lush jungle, meeting the mysterious pale gray-white creatures. Or follow the creeks, jumping over paths made by river rocks and listening to the running water.

Encounter beloved characters from Moomin stories, like the sweet Moominmama and mischievous Little My. Whimsical little critters like worms and black birds who enjoy tunes from Snufkin’s harmonica will also make charmingly helpful appearances in aiding exploration and puzzle-solving. Dramatic spiders, timid creatures like Sniff and Teety-Woo, and the misunderstood, icy Groke fill Moominvalley with colorful personalities and charming interactions. 

We can’t wait for everybody to leap into Snufkin: Melody of Moominvalley on March 7! See you there 💚
